generation.scope: Finite one-sided symmetric windows of opposite rank greater than six are reconstructed from a three-layer commutative module of Hilbert vector (4,6,4), with a fixed complete Betti table. When its linear syzygies give a subbundle the window is classified up to indexed isomorphism by a charge-four instanton bundle up to projective coordinates, and this includes an explicit regular window.

open_mathematics: Control the degeneracy of the four linear syzygies and the torsion-free instanton boundary, relate unstable planes and jumping lines to point modules, and determine regularity on the instanton locus.
